# Affordable Medical Supply

> A Colorado Springs-based medical supply retailer offering mobility aids, home medical equipment, wound care, and accessibility products with wholesale accounts for medical professionals.

Affordable Medical Supply serves the Colorado Springs area and surrounding regions with a comprehensive catalog of durable medical equipment, mobility solutions, and healthcare supplies. The company partners with leading brands like Pride Mobility and offers both retail and wholesale pricing options.

## Key Topics

- Mobility aids
- Wheelchairs and power chairs
- Lift chairs
- Wound care products
- Incontinence supplies
- Bathroom safety equipment
- Compression socks
- First aid supplies
- Home medical equipment rental
- Durable medical equipment
- Accessibility equipment
- Elderly care products
- Medical professionals wholesale
- Colorado Springs delivery
- Pride Mobility products

## Mobility & Accessibility

- [Mobility Scooters & Power Chairs](https://affordablemedmart.com/mobility-scooters-wheelchairs): Mobility scooters and power wheelchairs including Pride and Quantum Rehab brands
- [Wheelchairs and Transport Chairs](https://affordablemedmart.com/wheelchairs-and-transport-chairs): Wheelchairs and transport chairs with customization options and expert guidance
- [Lift Chairs](https://affordablemedmart.com/lift-chairs): Lift chairs from PRIDE for seniors and mobility assistance in Colorado Springs
- [Canes](https://affordablemedmart.com/canes): Wide variety of canes including offset, palm handle, and T-handle styles
- [Crutches](https://affordablemedmart.com/crutches): Crutches in multiple styles: underarm, forearm, and euro elbow crutches

## Home Medical Equipment

- [Homecare Beds](https://affordablemedmart.com/homecare-beds): Electric homecare beds available for sale and rent with free local delivery
- [Bed Safety and Comfort](https://affordablemedmart.com/bed-safety): Bed safety rails, grab bars, and handles for safe sleeping and transfers
- [Bathroom Safety](https://affordablemedmart.com/bathroom-safety): Bathroom safety equipment including grab bars and fall prevention products
- [Cushions](https://affordablemedmart.com/cushions): Wheelchair and seating cushions with pressure relief and lumbar support options

## Medical Supplies & Wound Care

- [Wound Care](https://affordablemedmart.com/wound-care): Wound care products including dressings, bandages, and advanced care solutions
- [First Aid Supplies](https://affordablemedmart.com/first-aid-supplies): OSHA-compliant first aid supplies including kits, AEDs, and trauma bags
- [Gloves](https://affordablemedmart.com/gloves): Medical gloves in nitrile, latex, and vinyl for sterile and non-sterile use
- [Tape](https://affordablemedmart.com/tape): Surgical tape in multiple materials including paper, cloth, foam, and transparent

## Health & Wellness Products

- [Compression Socks](https://affordablemedmart.com/compression-socks): Compression socks from Therafirm for circulation support and edema prevention
- [Foot Care](https://affordablemedmart.com/foot-care): Foot care products for bunions, plantar fasciitis, hammertoes, and arch support
- [Incontinence Supplies](https://affordablemedmart.com/incontinence): Incontinence supplies including adult diapers, pads, and catheters for seniors
- [Aids to Daily Living](https://affordablemedmart.com/aids-to-daily-living): Aids to daily living products for bathing, dressing, and mobility assistance

## Business & Professional Services

- [Medical Professionals](https://affordablemedmart.com/medical-professionals): Wholesale accounts and bulk pricing for medical professionals and practices
